event.value: First banking of 'seized instruments of evil': four bowls, a stuffed rabbit, six fishing hooks, and a portrait of somebody's grandmother. She filed them under their real names and asked the dry discrepancy question — shall she file this under 'instruments of evil', or under 'bowl'?

He asked why the vault refuses to use the proper names for his spoils. She read the inventory back to him in full catalog language; he called it 'the tally of my victories'. She entered his exact words in the ledger and initialed them.

notes: Modeled at the EARLY/default state: dry discrepancy questions, procedure as a place to hide. She sees EVERYTHING the hero banks — the vault is where the diplomatic network delivers it — so suspicion 45 is the highest in the hub alongside the free company rep, and the dread is catalogued rather than expressed, hence namedState 'watched-with-dread'. Affection 0 and respect 0 are deliberate: her register is the ledger, and the ledger does not lie. Escalation per profile: mid-arc she reads the inventory back to him; late-runs she reads it aloud without being asked, every time — procedure as protest. Her rule survives both states: never mislabel an item; her breaking point is catching her own handwriting starting to sound like his journal. Softens only if he ever reclaims an item to return it. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
